items.doc_text: Exams » CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 The Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board (CG Vyapam) has officially released the Assistant Development Extension Officer (ADEO) Result 2025. Candidates who appeared for the exam can now check their results and merit list online. Read the full article below for the CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 complete details and download links. CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 Out The ADEO25 exam was conducted by the Development Commissioner’s Office, Nava Raipur, on the proposal of the Additional Development Commissioner. Model answers were first published on the Vyapam website, and the final answers were released after reviewing candidates’ objections. The final results were declared on 14 August 2025 . CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025: Overview The Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board has officially released the CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 merit list. Candidates who appeared for the Assistant Development Extension Officer (ADEO) exam can now check their results online. CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025: Overview Exam CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 Conducted By CG Vyapam Post Name Assistant Development Extension Officer (ADEO) Category Result PDF / Scorecard Total Vacancies 200 Exam Date 15th June 2025 Result Release Date 14th August 2025 Official Website vyapam.cgstate.gov.in/ CG Vyapam ADEO Result PDF 2025 The CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 has been released by the Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board. Candidates can download the result PDF to check their scores and merit list. The official PDF helps candidates verify results and know the next steps in the recruitment process. CG Vyapam ADEO Scorecard 2025 Out – Download PDF CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 Download Link Candidates who appeared for the CG Vyapam ADEO Exam 2025 can now check their results online. We’ve provided the direct result PDF link below to help candidates easily view their scores, merit list, and cut-off marks from the official website. CG Vyapam ADEO Exam Result Link CG Vyapam ADEO Cut Off Marks 2025 Candidates who appeared for the written examination can now check their scores and merit list online. However, the CG Vyapam ADEO Cut Off Marks 2025 will be released only after the completion of the interview round. The final cut-off list will be prepared by combining the marks obtained in both the written test and the interview. The cut-off marks for CG Vyapam will differ for General, OBC, SC, ST, and EWS categories. They depend on vacancies, the number of candidates, and exam difficulty. After the selection process, CG Vyapam will release category-wise and post-wise cut-off marks on the official website. How To Check And Download The CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 Candidates can easily check and download the CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 online from the official website. Follow the simple steps below to access your merit list and cut-off PDF. Visit https://vyapamprofile.cgstate.gov.in/online/. Log in using your credentials (registration number and password/date of birth). Navigate to the ADEO25 Result section. Download the PDF of your scorecard and save it for future reference. Details Mentioned On CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 The CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 offers important details for candidates who took the exam, including their name, roll number, and marks obtained. By checking these details, candidates can verify their results and monitor their selection progress. The scorecard features: What’s Next After CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025? Candidates shortlisted from the written exam will be called for the interview round . The final merit list will be prepared based on marks from both stages – the written exam and the interview. Applicants should regularly visit the Vyapam website for interview dates and important instructions. CG ADEO Helpline & Contact Details In case of any issues related to CG ADEO Result download, discrepancy in scorecard, or technical problems, candidates can contact the official helpline of Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board (CG Vyapam): Helpline Number: 0771-2972780 / 0771-2972781 Official Website: vyapam.cgstate.gov.in FAQs Where can I check the CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025? Candidates can check the result on the official website vyapam.cgstate.gov.in. What details are mentioned in the ADEO result PDF? The PDF includes candidate name, roll number, marks obtained, category, and qualifying status. When will the CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 be released? The CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 has been officially released on the CG Vyapam website. How can I check my CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025? You can download the CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 PDF from the official site using your roll number. Where can I download the CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025? The CG Vyapam ADEO Result 2025 is available on the official website at vyapam.cgstate.gov.in. items.doc_text: Exams » CG Fire Department Recruitment 2025 The Chhattisgarh Fire Department has opened its doors for recruitment in 2025, offering a total of 295 vacancies across multiple essential roles including Fireman, Station Officer, Driver, Mechanic, and more. With the application window closing on 31 July 2025, aspiring candidates still have time to submit their forms and be part of this vital emergency service force. This is a golden opportunity for individuals looking to serve in a disciplined and high-responsibility profession. The last date to apply online for the CG Fire Department Recruitment 2025 is 31 July , with the correction window open till 10 August 2025 . CG Fire Department Recruitment 2025 The Chhattisgarh Fire Department Recruitment 2025 presents a promising career opportunity for candidates holding qualifications like 10+2, B.Sc, B.E, or Diploma across various technical and non-technical roles. The official notification is available on the department’s website, detailing post-wise eligibility, educational criteria, and selection procedures. With the last date to apply—31 July 2025—fast approaching , interested applicants are urged not to wait till the final hours. Visit the official portal now, review the eligibility norms carefully, and submit your application using the direct link provided below before the deadline closes. Candidates interested in applying can check the key details shared below: Chhattisgarh Fire Department Recruitment 2025 Recruiting Organisation Chhattisgarh Fire Department Post Name Fireman, Station Officer, Vehicle Driver, Storekeeper, Mechanic, Watchroom Operator and Wireless Operator posts Vacancies 295 Eligibility Criteria Varies from post to post Age limit 18-28 years Application Fees Rs. 300 (UR) Selection Procedure Written examination, PET/PMT, Skill test, Certificate verification Salary Varies from post to post Official Website https://cghgcd.gov.in/ Chhattisgarh Fire Dept Notification Important Date 2025 The candidates interested in applying for the CG Fire Department Recruitment 2025 should be aware of the key dates mentioned in the official notification. These help aspirants to know about the starting and ending dates to submit online application. Candidates interested in applying for various CG Fire Dept vacancies must carefully go through the detailed notification before applying. The online process started on 01 July to 31 July 2025. The notification PDF includes all key information such as eligibility criteria, age limit & relaxation, selection process, application steps, and more. To ensure accurate and timely application, candidates are advised to visit the official website or click the direct link below to download the CG Fire Department Notification 2025 PDF. Interested candidates can submit their online applications from 01 July to 31 July 2025. To complete the application process, candidates must register, fill out the form, and pay the required application fee. For your convenience, a direct link to apply for eligible posts has been shared below. CG Fire Departmet Apply Online Link 2025- Active Steps to Apply for Chhattisgarh Fire Department Vacancies 2025 To apply for Chhattisgarh Fire Department Vacancies 2025, candidates should register from the official website. Follow the below mentioned steps and submit your online application before the last date. Visit the official website of CG Fire Department @https://cghgcd.gov.in/ On the home page check for the ” Click on link for Chhattisgarh fire and emergency services recruitment for 295 posts” Check for “Registration link” and click on it. You will be redirected to a new web page. Fill in the required details to complete your registration process. Upload required documents and fill in the application Pay the required fees to submit your online application. Download or take a printout of your filled in application for future use. CG Fire Department Application Fees 2025 Candidates are required to pay application fees before the last date. Check the category wise fees distribution. Payment of fees is online mode only by using Credit Card, Net Banking, Debit Card etc. CG Fire Department Application Fees 2025 Category Fees UR/ OBC Rs. 300 SC/ST Rs. 200 CG Fire Department Eligibility Criteria 2025 Candidates interested in applying for the CG Fire Department Recruitment 2025 should meet the required educational qualifications and age limit prescribed by the commission. items.doc_text:
Exams » CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Exam Date... The Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board (CG Vyapam) has announced to recruit 660 Lab Attendant vacancies through CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Recruitment 2025. Thousands of candidates who applied are eagerly waiting for the department officials to release the exam date. The CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Exam Date 2025 helps aspirants to plan their study schedule and focus on the exam. The last date to apply online for CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Recruitment 2025 was closed on 30th June. Aspirants who applied should kick start their preparation ahead of the CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Exam Date 2025. CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Exam Date 2025 CG Vyapam has released the official notification for 880 Lab Attendant posts. Interested and eligible candidates who submitted their online application before the closing date should go through the detailed exam pattern and prepare for the exam. The CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Notification 2025 covers all essential information, including important dates, eligibility criteria, selection process, exam pattern, syllabus, and application procedure. Chhattisgarh Lab Attendant Recruitment 2025 Candidates interested in applying can now check the key details about the Chhattisgarh Lab Attendant Recruitment 2025 that are shared below. These details provide an overview of the recruitment process. CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Recruitment 2025 Recruiting Organisation Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board Post Name Lab Attendant, Peon, Watchman, Sweeper Vacancies 880 Application Dates 9 June to 30 June 2025 Educational Qualification 12 standard Age Limit 18-40 years Selection Procedure Written exam, Certificate verification Exam fees Rs. 350 (UR) Official Website https://vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in/ CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Notification 2025 The Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board, Raipur, has released the CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Notification 2025, announcing vacancies for Lab Assistant, Peon, Watchman, and Sweeper posts. This is a great opportunity for 10th and 12th pass candidates looking for government jobs in Chhattisgarh. Aspirants can check post-wise and category-wise vacancy details in the official notification CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Notification 2025 CG Vyapam Peon Sweeper Vacancy 2025 Chhattisgarh Laboratory Attendant, Peon, and Other Vacancies 2025 CG Vyapam has announced 880 vacancies across various posts. The online application for Laboratory Attendant is now active, with recruitment for other posts starting soon. Candidates can check the post-wise and category-wise vacancy details below. Post Name Vacancies UR SC ST OBC EWS UR (Women) SC (Women) ST (Women) OBC (Women) EWS (Women) PwBD Laboratory Attendant 430 180 51 138 61 54 15 41 18 36 10 30 (OL, HH) Office Attendant/ Peon 210 88 25 67 30 26 7 20 9 18 5 15 (OA, OL, B, LV, HH) Watchman 210 88 26 67 29 26 7 20 8 18 5 – Sweeper 30 12 4 10 4 3 1 3 1 2 1 2 (OA, OL, LV, HH) Total 880 368 106 282 124 110 30 84 36 74 21 47 CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Apply Online 2025 The online application process for CG Vyapam Lab Attendant 430 Vacancies has been completed. The application window, which was open from 09 June to 30 June 2025, is now closed. Candidates who have successfully applied will be eligible to appear for the examination. The CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Exam Date 2025 is expected to be announced soon on the official website. Applicants are advised to regularly check for updates regarding the exam schedule and admit card release. CG Vyapam Lab Technician Apply Online 2025 Steps to Apply for CG Vyapam Lab Technician Vacancy 2025 Candidates who are not aware of the CG Vyapam Lab Technician Application 2025 can check the steps mentioned below and submit their online application Go to the CG Vyapam website @https://vyapam.cgstate.gov.in. On the home page, check for the Lab Technician Application Link and click on it. Fill in basic details like Name, Total Marks, Marks Obtained, Passing Year and Roll Number. Complete all the required fields and Basic information. Upload required documents and select your preferred examination district. Agree to the declaration by clicking on “I Agree”. Finally, click on “Submit” to complete your application. In case of any problem in filling the online application, you can contact on number 0771-2972780 between 10:00 am to 5:30 pm (office hours) on working days. Also, on holidays, you can contact on mobile number 8269801982 from 10:00 am to 5:30 pm. Documents Required for CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Application 2025 Candidates applying for the CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Recruitment 2025 must keep the following documents ready: Recent passport-size photograph (as per specifications) Scanned signature Aadhaar card or any valid ID proof 10th and 12th mark sheets Caste certificate (if applicable) Domicile certificate (for Chhattisgarh residents) Disability certificate (if applicable) Valid email ID and mobile number Note: All documents should be clear and legible while uploading. CG Vyapam Lab Technician Application Fees Candidates interested in applying should pay the CG Vyapam Lab Technician Application Fees to submit their online application. Fees not paid or incomplete applications will not be accepted by the commission. Here, we have shared the detailed category wise fee distribution: CG Vyapam Lab Technician Application Fees Category Application Fees Gen Rs.350 OBC Rs.250 SC/ST Rs.200 CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Eligibility Criteria Below is the detailed eligibility criteria for the CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Vacancy 2025, including educational qualifications, age limits, and merit list weightage. Criteria Details Educational Qualification 12th Standard Minimum Age 18 years Maximum Age 30 years (General), 40 years (reserved candidates) CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Selection Process The selection process of CG Vyapam Lab Attendant includes two stages, i.e, a written examination and certificate verification. The candidates who clear the written examination will be provisionally shortlisted to appear for the final selection. CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Exam Pattern 2025 Candidates should be aware of the detailed exam pattern. The CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Exam Pattern includes: The question paper will have 100 objective-type questions. Each question will carry 1 mark. Total duration: 2 hours (120 minutes). For each question, four options will be given. Candidates must choose one correct option using a blue or black dot pen on the OMR sheet. Wrong Answer / Multiple Answers: ¼ (0.25) mark will be deducted Unanswered Questions: Will be given zero (0) marks CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Exam Pattern 2025 Subject Marks Duration General Science (Bio, Physics, Chem) 50 2 hours General Knowledge (incl. CG GK) 20 Reasoning & Quantitative Aptitude 20 Hindi Language 10 Total 100 CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Salary 2025 The candidates who clear all the stages and are provisionally shortlisted for the CG Vyapam Lab Attendant will get a salary and other allowances from the government. The allowances include HRA, TA, DA, ESI, Insurance, PF etc. The employees salary ranges from Rs 18,000 to Rs.56,900. Also check CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Syllabus FAQs How many vacancies are released for CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Recruitment 2025? The department officials will soon release the CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Exam Date 2025 on the official website. What is the selection process of CG Vyapam Lab Attendant Exam 2025? The selection process of the CG Vyapam Lab Attendant includes written exam, certificate verification. प्रयोगशाला परिचारक के रिक्त 430 पदों पर भर्ती हेतु संबंधित विभाग द्वारा अभ्यर्थियों की जानकारी व्यापम को
प्राप्त हुई। उक्त अभ्यर्थियों को लिखित परीक्षा का प्रवेश पत्र प्राप्त करने के लिए छ.ग. व्यापम वेबसाइट के
लिंक में जाकर पंजीयन करना अनिवार्य होगा। व्यापम में पंजीयन के उपरांत अभ्यर्थी लिखित परीक्षा के
ऑनलाइन आवेदन में सबमिट बटन अवश्य दबायें |

'जिस अभ्यर्थी का व्यापम में प्रोफाइल पूर्व में निर्मित नहीं है उन्हें प्रोफाइल निर्मित करना आवश्यक होगा

तदुपरांत ही लिखित परीक्षा ऑनलाइन आवेदन की सुविधा प्राप्त होगी |
अभ्यर्थी द्वारा छ.ग. व्यापम के वेबसाइट में जाकर ऑनलाइन आवेदन पत्र को सफलतापूर्वक सबमिट
(SUBMIT) नहीं किया जायेगा वे अभ्यर्थी लिखित परीक्षा से वंचित होंगे | इसकी संपूर्ण जिम्मेदारी अभ्यर्थी
की स्वयं की होगी तथा इस सम्बंध में कोई पत्राचार स्वीकार नहीं होंगे | लिखित परीक्षा के ऑनलाइन आवेदन
पत्र को सफलतापूर्वक सबमिट करने के बाद कृपया इसका प्रिंट आउट अपने पास अनिवार्य रूप से रखें |
ऑनलाइन आवेदन के साथ अभ्यर्थी की जाति, जन्मतिथि, स्थानीय निवासी, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, दिव्यांगता,
भूतपूर्व सैनिक आदि सम्बंधी प्रमाण-पत्र नहीं लिए जा रहे हैं। अभ्यर्थी के सभी प्रमाण-पत्र का परीक्षण
नियुक्तिकर्ता प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया जायेगा | अभ्यर्थी द्वारा दी गई कोई भी जानकारी के लिए व्यापम जवाबदार
नहीं होगा | इसका संपूर्ण उत्तरदायित्व अभ्यर्थी का स्वयं का होगा |

ऑनलाइन आवेदन भरते समय, परीक्षा शुल्क का सफलतापूर्वक भुगतान करने के बाद अभ्यर्थी अपने आवेदन
को “SUBMIT” करने हेतु अनिवार्य रूप से “SUBMIT” बटन दबाएँ अन्यथा परीक्षा शुल्क भुगतान के
बावजूद भी अभ्यर्थी का ऑनलाइन आवेदन मान्य नहीं होगा, जिसकी संपूर्ण जिम्मेदारी अभ्यर्थी की स्वयं की
होगी |

अभ्यर्थी का वैध E-mail (ई मेल) आई.डी. होना आवश्यक है | अतः अभ्यर्थी अपना E-mail बनाकर तैयार
रखे। व्यापम के वेबसाइट vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in में नया ऑनलाइन प्रोफाइल रजिस्ट्रेशन (पंजीकरण)
फार्म भरने हेतु अभ्यर्थी अपना wa का सामने से लिया हुआ फोटो jpe/.jpee wric में स्कैन कर कर
फाइल के रूप में रखें। जिसका अधिकतम साइज 00 kb एवं न्यूनतम साइज 50 kb का हो, सेव कर रखें।
(फाइल का नाम अल्पफान्यूमेरिक में रखें, बीच में अंतराल तथा डॉट का प्रयोग न करें) साथ ही अभ्यर्थी अपने
स्वयं के हस्ताक्षर का फोटो भी स्कैन कर कर एक अलग jpg/jpeg wre में फाइल के रूप में रखे।
जिसका अधिकतम साइज l00 kb एवं न्यूनतम साइज 50 kb का हो, सेव कर रखें।

items.title: CG Police SI Bharti 2024, 341 Vacancies Application Link Active Till 25th December
items.doc_text: Exams » CG Police SI Bharti 2024 Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission (CGPSC) has announced to recruit 341 candidates through CG Police SI Bharti 2024 for the post of Sub Inspector, Subedar, and Platoon Commander. The online application link has been active since 23rd October 2024 and the last date to submit online application has reactivated till 25th December 2024. Candidates who are interested in applying for CG Police SI must not miss the last date and apply as soon as possible. In this article, we have provided detailed steps to apply along with the CG Police SI Apply Online application link. CG Police SI Bharti 2024 Out The official notification pdf for the Chhattisgarh Police SI Recruitment 2024 is available on the official website of CGPSC @https://psc.cg.gov.in/. The final selection of the candidates will be done based on written test, physical standard test, physical efficiency test and document verification. The CGPSC has re activated the CG Police SI Apply Online 2024 link on the official website, with only two days left candidates should utilise this opportunity and apply. Candidates can apply for 341 posts of SI, Subedar, and Platoon Commander from 23rd October 2024 to 21st November 2024. The official notification consists of all the details that a candidate must know before applying for any of the posts. The direct link to download the official notification pdf is given below. Sub-Inspector (Fingerprints) and Sub-Inspector (Questioned Documents) A bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry from a university recognized by the government or an equivalent degree. items.title: Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Result 2024 Out, Download Van Rakshak PET Merit List PDF
items.doc_text: Exams » Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Result 2024 The Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board (CG Vyapam) has released the Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Result 2024 for the Physical Test on 07th December 2024 . The CG Forest Guard exam was conducted by CG Vyapam on 22nd September 2024 to fill 1484 vacancies in the Chhattisgarh Forest & Climate Change Department. Candidates who will be clearing the written examination will be shortlisted for the next stage of the recruitment process. In this article, we have provided all the important details related to Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Result 2024. Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Result 2024 Out The Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Result 2024 PET Merit list will be published in a PDF format on the official website of CG Vyapam @vyapam.cgstate.gov.in and Forest department @forest.cg.gov.in. The final selection of the candidates will be done on the basis of the Physical Efficiency Test, Physical Standard Test and the written examination. The roll number of successful candidates will be included in the result pdf. CG Forest Guard Result 2024 Key Highlights The Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Result 2024 will be announced for the candidates who appeared in the written examination. The forest guard exam was conducted for 100 marks having three sections i.e. General Knowledge, Reasoning, and Maths. In the table given below, we have provided key highlights of the CG Forest Guard Recruitment 2024 . Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Result 2024 Overview Recruitment Body Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board (CG Vyapam) Post Name Forest Guard No. of vacancies 1484 Category Result CG Forest Guard Exam Date 22nd September 2024 CG Forest Guard Result 2024 Date 07th December 2024 Official website vyapam.cgstate.gov.in Chhattisgarh Forest Guard PET Result 2024 PDF Download Link The link to download the Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Result 2024 has been activated on the official website of CG Vyapam. Candidates can able to check their qualifying status with the help of their roll number. Aspirants can visit the official website or click the link below and download CG Van Rakshak PET Result 2024. CG Forest Guard 2024 Link : The merit list pdf link will be available in the result tab Search Your Roll Number: Now search your roll number in the result pdf using CTRL+F to check your qualifying status. Download and Print : Download your result and print it for future references. Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Cut-Off 2024 Cut-off are the minimum number of marks that candidates must achieve in order to get shortlisted for the next stage of the recruitment process. The cut-off is a very dynamic thing that depends upon multiple factors like the number of candidates who appeared in the examination, the difficulty level of the exam, and the average number of attempts. The cut-off will be different for each category. The Vyapam Board will release the cut-off along with the result. FAQs When will the CG Forest Guard Result 2024 be released? items.doc_text:
Exams » CG Forest Guard Exam Date 2024 The Forest Department, Government of Chhattisgarh has announced the CG Forest Guard Exam Date 2024 on the official website at https://forest.cg.gov.in/ for the Forest Guard post. Candidates who applied online and passed the departmental physical efficiency test have been issued admit cards for the exam. To appear for the exam, candidates must register on the Vyapam website and select their examination district. Read this article for more details about the CG Forest Guard Exam Date and other important details below. CG Forest Guard Exam Date 2024 Out The CG Forest Guard Exam Date 2024 for the written examination has been released through an official notice. The Chhattisgarh Vanrakshak Exam Date 2024 is scheduled to be held on 22 September 2024 (Sunday) in the morning. The CG Forest Guard Admit Card will be issued based on this registration. Candidates who fail to register on the Vyapam website will not be allowed to take the exam, and the responsibility for this lies with the candidates themselves. No changes or corrections will be allowed in the already submitted online application forms. Download Chhattisgarh Vanrakshak Exam Date 2024 Notice PDF CG Forest Guard Exam Date 2024 Event Dates and Details Starting date of registration and examination district selection 23.08.2024 (Friday) Last date of registration and examination district selection 08.09.2024 (Sunday) till 11:59 pm CG Forest Guard Admit Card Release Date 16.09.2024 (Monday) CG Forest Guard Exam Date 2024 22 September 2024 (Sunday) CG Forest Guard Exam Time 10:00 am to 12:15 pm Examination Center Bilaspur and Raipur CG Forest Guard Recruitment 2024 The CG Forest Guard Exam 2024 will be conducted to recruit eligible for the post of the Forest Guard for which 1484+67 (Driver post). The exam will be conducted in a state-level exam in which thousands of candidates are going to appear in this exam. CG Forest Guard Recruitment 2024 Organization Forest Department, Government of Chhattisgarh Exam Name Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Exam 2024 Post Name Forest Guard Vacancy 1484+67 [Driver] Category Notification Application Start [Re-opened Dates] 12th June to 1st July 2024 Job Location Chhattisgarh Official Website https://forest.cg.gov.in/ CG Vanrakshak Bharti 2024: Important Dates The exam date for CG Vanrakshak has been released for the written exam. Candidates can check the table below for important date regarding the CG Forest Guard Recruitment below. Events Dates Application Starts 20th May 2024 Last Date to Apply 11 June 2024 Application Process Re-starts 12th June 2024 Last Date to Apply 1st July 2024 (11:59 PM) Exam Date 22 September 2024 The Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Recruitment 2024 Notification has been released on the official website of the Forest Department, Government of Chhattisgarh at https://forest.cg.gov.in/. Candidates can download their notification pdf by using the direct link in the article below. CG Forest Guard Recruitment 2024 Download PDF CG Forest Guard Apply Online 2024 Candidates who are interested and want to fill up their online application form can now fill up their application form. The application process was re-started on 12th June 2024 and the last date of Form submission is 1st July 2024. Candidates can use the direct link which is provided in the below article. CG Forest Guard Apply Online 2024 Link (Window Closed) Steps to Apply for CG Vanrakshak Bharti 2024 Follow the steps given below to apply for the CG Forest Guard Vacancy 2024: Visit the official website of FOREST & CLIMATE CHANGE DEPARTMENT, Chhattisgarh Government @https://forest.cg.gov.in/. Now, on the homepage, go to the Recruitment section, and click on “Advertisement for filling application for direct recruitment to 1484 posts of forest guard’ Or ‘Advertisement for filling application for direct recruitment to the post of driver’ (the post that you want to apply for). Now, make registration and a unique Registration ID and password will be provided to you. After that proceed to the online application form fill up and enter the details that are asked about you in the form. Upload documents and pay the application fee. Now, submit the form and take a printout of it. CG Forest Guard Application Fees 2024 To apply for the Forest Guard position in the Forest Department of Chhattisgarh, candidates from the General or Other Backward Class categories must pay a fee of ₹350. For those from the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe categories, the fee is ₹250. CG Forest Guard Vacancy 2024 In the official notification of Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Recruitment 2024, there are a total of 1484 vacancies available. Candidates who want to know about vacancies according to their posts can check the below table. CG Guard Vacancy 2024 Post Vacancy Forest Division Raipur 199 Forest Division Durg 192 Forest Division Bilaspur 355 Forest Division Sarguja 295 Forest Division Kanker 208 Forest Division Kanker 235 CG Forest Guard Eligibility Criteria 2024 Candidates who will fill out their online application form are suggested to check the required eligibility criteria given in the notification. Check the eligibility criteria which are given in the below article. Age Limit Applicants must be between 18 and 40 years old. For candidates from the OBC category, the maximum age limit is extended by 3 years, and for SC candidates, it is extended by 5 years. Education Qualifications Candidates must have completed their 12th-grade education in Science, Commerce, Arts, or Vocational stream from a school affiliated with either CBSE in New Delhi or CGBSE in Raipur. Physical Measurement Standards The PMT criteria for the male and female candidates including the height and chest measurements is given below. Criteria Male Candidates Female Candidates Height Minimum 163 cm Minimum 150 cm Chest (Normal) 79 cm Not applicable Chest (Expanded) 84 cm Not applicable CG Forest Guard Selection Process 2024 The selection process for the Forest Guard position includes three stages: a Written Exam, a Physical Efficiency and Standard Test (PET/PST), and Document Verification. Written Exam Physical Efficiency Test/ Driving Test Document Verification CG Forest Guard Exam Pattern 2024 The exam pattern for the Chhattisgarh Vanrakshak Exam has been discussed here. The exam will be conducted in an offline manner and the questions shall be MCQ type. Each correct answer carries 1 mark and 0.25 marks are deducted for each incorrect answer. The medium of the exam shall be Bilingual (English and Hindi). CG Forest Guard Exam Pattern 2024 Subjects Questions Marks Duration Exam Mode General Knowledge, General Hindi, Mental Ability, and Numerical Ability 150 Questions 150 marks 2 hours (120 minutes) Offline (Pen and Paper-based) CG Forest Guard Physical Efficiency Test The events included in the CG Vanrakshak Physical Efficiency Test are walking and running. The event and duration for male, female, and transgender candidates is given in the table below. Criteria Male Candidates Female Candidates Transgender Candidates Event 25 km walk 14 km walk 800 meters run Time Duration 4 hours 3 hours 2 hours CG Forest Guard Admit Card 2024 The admit card for the Chattisgarh Vanrakshak Bharti 2024 written exam will be released on the official website of the CG Forest department. It will be made available a few days before the exam and candidates will be able to download it by logging in with their registration credentials. We will share the direct link to download the hall ticket here. CG Forest Guard Salary 2024 Selected candidates for the Forest Guard position under the Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Recruitment 2024 will receive a salary in pay level 4, which ranges from ₹5200 to ₹20200, with a grade pay of ₹1900. FAQs How many vacancies are available for the Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Recruitment 2024? There are a total of 1484 vacancies available for the Forest Guard post and 67 vacancies are notified for Driver post. What are the application fees for the Chhattisgarh Forest Guard Recruitment 2024? For General or OBC candidates, the application fee is ₹350. For SC/ST candidates, the fee is ₹250. How can I apply for the CG Vanrakshak Recruitment 2024? Candidates can apply for the CG Vanrakshak Recruitment 2024 through the direct link shared in this article. What is the selection process for the CG Forest Guard Recruitment 2024? For CG Forest Guard Recruitment 2024, the selection stages involve Written Test, PET, and Document Verification. What is the salary of Forest Guard in Chhattisgarh Forest department? The CG Forest Guard Salary is Rs. 5200-20200 and Grade pay- 1900/- per month. This includes basic pay and allowances as sanctioned by the Govt. What is the CG Forest Guard Exam date 2024? The CG Forest Guard Exam 2024 is scheduled to be held on 22 September 2024. Every candidates after downloading the result must check all details one by one. Candidate Name Registration Number Roll Number Qualifying Status MP Police Constable Normalisation Formula 2026 The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) uses a normalisation process to ensure fairness in exams conducted in multiple shifts. For the 2025–26 recruitment cycle, the board has adopted the Normalised Equi-Percentile (NEP) method, which adjusts marks based on the difficulty level of each shift. Normalised Marks (Mi) = [(Mgt – Mgq) / (Mti – Miq)] × (Mij – Miq) + Mgq Term Definitions M = Candidate’s raw marks Mₛ = Mean marks of the candidate’s shift Sₛ = Standard deviation of the candidate’s shift Mₜ = Mean marks of all shifts combined S = Standard deviation of all shifts combined How Normalisation Affects Your Score? Normalisation affects your sore in many ways, and these are: Tougher Shift – If your shift had lower average marks (paper was difficult), your normalised score may increase. Easier Shift – If your shift had higher average marks (paper was easier), your score may remain same or slightly decrease. Fair Comparison- This method ensures that all candidates are evaluated on a common scale, regardless of shift difficulty. Candidates can follow these steps one by one and download the result. सबसे पहले आधिकारिक वेबसाइट esb.mp.gov.in पर जाएं। होमपेज पर “Result” या “Latest Updates” सेक्शन खोजें। वहां “MP Police Constable Result 2026” के लिंक पर क्लिक करें। अब अपना Application Number और Date of Birth दर्ज करें। “Search / Submit” बटन पर क्लिक करें। आपका रिजल्ट स्क्रीन पर दिखाई देगा। रिजल्ट को डाउनलोड करें और भविष्य के लिए प्रिंट निकाल लें। Details Mentioned On the MP Police Final Result Here, we have provided the list of details, which includes the MP Police Final Result for the constable exam. Every candidates after downloading the result must check all details one by one. Candidate Name Registration Number Roll Number Qualifying Status MP Police Constable Normalisation Formula 2026 The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) uses a normalisation process to ensure fairness in exams conducted in multiple shifts. For the 2025–26 recruitment cycle, the board has adopted the Normalised Equi-Percentile (NEP) method, which adjusts marks based on the difficulty level of each shift. Normalised Marks (Mi) = [(Mgt – Mgq) / (Mti – Miq)] × (Mij – Miq) + Mgq Term Definitions M = Candidate’s raw marks Mₛ = Mean marks of the candidate’s shift Sₛ = Standard deviation of the candidate’s shift Mₜ = Mean marks of all shifts combined S = Standard deviation of all shifts combined How Normalisation Affects Your Score? Normalisation affects your sore in many ways, and these are: Tougher Shift – If your shift had lower average marks (paper was difficult), your normalised score may increase. Easier Shift – If your shift had higher average marks (paper was easier), your score may remain same or slightly decrease. Fair Comparison- This method ensures that all candidates are evaluated on a common scale, regardless of shift difficulty. items.title: MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Exam Date 2026 Out, Check Details for 454 Vacancies
items.doc_text:
Exams » MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3... The MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Exam Date 2026 has been officially announced. The Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) will conduct the written examination for 454 posts on 28 January 2026. This recruitment provides an excellent opportunity for candidates seeking a secure and government career in Madhya Pradesh. Aspirants are advised to stay focused on their preparation by following the latest exam pattern and syllabus, practicing mock tests, and revising key topics regularly. MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Exam Date 2026 Out The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (ESB) has issued a notice regarding the Group-02 and Sub Group-03 Combined Recruitment Exam 2025. The exam, earlier scheduled from 23 January 2026, has now been postponed to start from 28 January 2026 due to unavoidable reasons. The admit cards will be available online on the official website esb.mp.gov.in for candidates to download. MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Important Instructions for Exam Day Candidates appearing for the MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Exam 2026 must strictly follow the exam-day instructions mentioned on the admit card and official notification. Reaching the exam centre on time and carrying the required documents is mandatory to avoid any last-minute issues. Important Instructions (Points): Carry a printed copy of the admit card to the exam centre Bring a valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card, etc.) Reach the exam centre well before the reporting time Follow all COVID/administrative guidelines (if applicable) Electronic gadgets, calculators, mobile phones, and smart watches are not allowed Use only blue/black ballpoint pen for OMR sheet filling Follow instructions given by invigilators carefully MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Notification 2025 Out The MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Notification 2025 was officially revised on 24 October 2025. Following this update, the online application window was reopened on 29 October 2025; however, the final date for submitting the application form has now passed. Even though the application process has ended, candidates should carefully read the official notification PDF for complete and accurate recruitment details. It includes important information such as total vacancies, eligibility criteria, exam pattern, detailed syllabus, and selection process. The notification is a key guide for candidates preparing for the MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Examination 2025, which will be conducted in offline (OMR-based) mode. MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025: Overview The MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025 has been announced with 454 vacancies across 43 posts. MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025 Recruitment Organization Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) Advt. No. MPESB Group 2 (Sub Group 3) Combined Recruitment Test 2025 Post Name Various Posts Revised Vacancies 454 Salary/ Pay Scale Varies Post Wise Revised Notification Date 24 October 2025 Application Dates 29 October – 12 November 2025 Exam Date Start From 28 January 2026 Category MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Notification 2025 Official Website esb.mp.gov.in MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Admit Card 2025 – Download Link MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Notification 2025 PDF The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has officially published the Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment Notification 2025, inviting applications for 454 vacancies across 43 posts in various Madhya Pradesh government departments. For the ease of candidates, the direct download link for the MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Notification 2025 PDF is provided below. The official notification includes complete and detailed information regarding eligibility criteria, age limit, post-wise vacancy details, required educational qualifications, and the step-by-step online application process, enabling applicants to apply smoothly, accurately, and without errors for their preferred post. MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Notification 2025 – Download PDF MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Important Dates 2025-26 The MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025-26 notification lists all key dates, from registration to the written exam. Aspirants should note them carefully to avoid missing deadlines. Events Dates Notification Date 2 September 2025 Apply Start Date 29 October 2025 Apply Last Date 12 November 2025 Last Date to Modify Application Form 17 November 2025 MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Exam Date Starts From 28 January 2026 MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Vacancies 2025 The MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025 brings a total of 454 vacancies spread across 43 different posts. Candidates can explore opportunities in both technical and non-technical roles under this recruitment drive. MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Vacancies 2025 Category Vacancies Number of Posts (Types) 43 Total Vacancies 454 Steps to Apply for MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025 Candidates can complete their application process online by following these steps: Go to the official website – esb.mp.gov.in Find and click on the “Apply Online” link for Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025 Fill in the application form with accurate personal, educational, and contact details Upload all the required scanned documents in the prescribed format Pay the applicable application fee through the available online payment modes Review the details and click on Submit to complete your application MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Application Fees The MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025 application will be accepted only after payment of the prescribed fee. The application fee varies by category and must be paid online through the official portal. MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Application Fees Category Fees General/ Other State Rs. 500/- SC/ ST/ EWS/ OBC/ PWD Rs. 250/- Mode of Payment Online MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Eligibility Criteria 2025 The eligibility criteria for the MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025 include educational qualifications and age requirements set by the board. Candidates must meet these standards to be considered for the 339 vacancies. Educational Qualification And Age Limits Criteria Details Educational Qualification Varies for each post. Candidates must possess the required degree/diploma as mentioned in the official notification. Age Limit : The minimum age is 18 years, with a maximum age of 40 years for unreserved candidates. Age relaxation is provided for reserved categories (SC, ST, OBC) and other groups, as per government rules. Citizenship : Candidates must be Indian citizens . Domicile : While candidates from all over India can apply, certain reservations and age relaxations are often exclusively for residents of Madhya Pradesh . MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Selection Process 2025 Candidates applying for the MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025 will be shortlisted through multiple stages of assessment. The selection procedure is designed to evaluate knowledge, skills, and overall suitability for the posts. The stages include: Written Examination – to test subject knowledge and aptitude Skill Test – applicable only for certain posts requiring technical/professional skills Document Verification – to validate eligibility and credentials Medical Examination – to ensure the candidate meets the required health standards Also check MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Syllabus FAQs How many vacancies are released under MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025? A total of 454 vacancies have been announced across 43 different posts. Where can I apply for MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 3 Recruitment 2025? Candidates can apply online through the official website esb.mp.gov.in from 29 October 2025. When will the MPESB Group 2 and Sub Group 3 Exam 2025 be conducted? The MPESB Group 2 and Sub Group 3 Exam will be conducted from 28 January 2026. Has the MPESB Group 2 and Sub Group 3 Exam Date 2026 been officially announced? Yes, MPESB has officially confirmed the exam date. Will the exam be conducted online or offline? The exam will be held in offline (OMR-based) mode. How should I prepare for the exam before 28 January 2026? Revise the full syllabus, practice previous-year papers, and solve mock tests regularly. Is the application process still open for this recruitment? No, the application window has already closed. items.title: MP Police ASI & Subedar Exam Date 2025 Out (500 Posts), Check Exam Details
items.doc_text:
Exams » MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MP ESB) has released the notification for the Subedar (Ministerial), Stenographer and Assistant Sub Inspector (Ministerial) Recruitment Examination 2026. A total of 655 vacancies have been announced for the MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026. Interested candidates can apply online from 24 September 2026 through the official website or a direct link which has been provided in the article. MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 Notification Out As per the recruitment notification, a total of 655 vacancies are available. The detailed notification contains information about vacancies, eligibility, application dates, examination scheme, selection process, fees and other important conditions. Candidates can download and read the MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF to check the complete recruitment rules before submitting their application. Download MP Police ASI Subedar Notification PDF 2026 MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026: Overview Candidates can check the important details of the MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 in the table below. MP Police ASI & Subedar Recruitment 2026: Overview Exam Name Subedar (Ministerial), Stenographer & Assistant Sub Inspector (Ministerial) Recruitment Examination 2026 Conducting Body Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MP ESB) Total Vacancies 655 Posts Subedar (Ministerial), Stenographer & ASI (Ministerial) Selection Process Written Exam, Practical Test & Document Verification, Physical Measurement & Medical Examination Official Website www.esb.mp.gov.in MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026: Important Dates The complete schedule for the MP Police Subedar (Steno) Recruitment 2026 has been provided in the MP ESB rulebook. Candidates should complete their applications within the prescribed dates. Event Date Online Application Begins 24 September 2026 Last Date to Apply 8 October 2026 Application Correction Ends 13 October 2026 Written Examination Begins 3 November 2026 MP Police ASI Vacancy 2026 The MP Police Recruitment examination is being conducted for 655 vacancies under the notified posts. The posts included in the recruitment are: Subedar (Ministerial) Stenographer Assistant Sub Inspector (Ministerial) The MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 rulebook mentions vacancies under six post codes across different branches and units. The post-wise vacancy details are given below. The vacancies are provisional and may be revised as per the recruitment rules. Post Code Post Name Branch/Unit Total Vacancies 01 Subedar (Ministerial)-Stenographer General Branch 125 02 Subedar (Ministerial)-Stenographer Special Branch 10 03 Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial) General Branch 100 04 Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial) Field Unit 370 05 Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial) Special Branch 25 06 Assistant Sub-Inspector (Ministerial) Crime Investigation Department (CID) 25 What Is The Eligibility Criteria? Candidates applying for the MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the prescribed educational qualification, age limit, physical standards and other eligibility conditions. The eligibility requirements for Subedar (Stenographer) and Assistant Sub Inspector (Ministerial) are given below. Educational Qualification Candidates must meet the following educational qualifications to be eligible for the respective posts under MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026. Subedar (Stenographer): Candidates must have passed Higher Secondary (10+2) or the equivalent examination from a recognised Board. Candidates must have passed Hindi shorthand with a speed of 100 words per minute from a recognised Board, Polytechnic, ITI or equivalent institution. Candidates must have passed the Computer Proficiency Certification Test (CPCT) conducted by the Department of Science and Technology, along with Hindi typing. Candidates must also possess any one of the prescribed computer qualifications, such as: Diploma-level examination conducted by DOEACC. One-year COPA (Computer Operator and Programming Assistant) certificate from a government-recognised ITI. Modern Office Management course from a recognised Polytechnic, College, University or ITI. Computer Diploma from a UGC-recognised institution or open university. Assistant Sub Inspector (Ministerial): Candidates must have passed Higher Secondary (10+2) or 12th from a recognised Board/Institution. Candidates must have passed the CPCT with Hindi typing conducted by the Department of Science and Technology. Hindi shorthand is not required for the ASI (Ministerial) post. Age Limit The age of candidates will be calculated as on 8 October 2026 . The min age is 18 years and maximum age limit prescribed under the recruitment rules is given below: Category (Varg) Maximum Age (Adhiktam Aayu) MP Domicile – Unreserved (UR) Male 33 Years MP Domicile – Unreserved (UR) Female 38 Years MP Domicile – Reserved (SC/ST/OBC) Male & Female 38 Years Other State Candidates (Unreserved) 33 Years Government/Corporation/Board/Autonomous Institution Employees 38 Years Vikram Award Winner – Male 38 Years (33 + 5) Vikram Award Winner – Female 43 Years (38 + 5) Eligible Inter-caste Marriage Candidates (Higher Caste Partner) Additional 5 Years (as per base category) Ex-Servicemen (Bhootpoorv Sainik) Actual age minus Army service period (max relaxation up to 3 years above upper limit) Physical Standards Candidates must fulfil the prescribed physical standards. No relaxation will be provided in the physical standards. Post Gender Minimum Height Chest Subedar (Stenographer) Male 162 cm Not Applicable Subedar (Stenographer) Female 152 cm Not Applicable ASI (Ministerial) Male 162 cm Not Applicable ASI (Ministerial) Female 152 cm Not Applicable Can Other State Candidates Apply? Yes, candidates from other states can apply for the MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026. However, they will be considered under the Unreserved (UR) category only and will not get the benefit of MP domicile-based reservation or age relaxation. MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026: Application Fee Candidates have to pay the prescribed application fee while submitting the MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 application form. The category-wise application fee is given Category Fee (for one paper) Unreserved (UR) Rs. 500/- SC/ST/OBC/EWS (MP Domicile only) Rs. 250/- MP Online Kiosk Charge (if applicable) Rs. 60/- Portal Charge (if not using kiosk) Rs. 20/- Note: Candidates who are not permanent domiciles of Madhya Pradesh must pay the Unreserved (UR) fee of Rs. 500/- MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 Apply Online Link The online application process for MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 has started on 24 September 2026. Eligible candidates can submit their application form through the official MP ESB website until 8 October 2026. Candidates should fill in all details carefully and complete the fee payment within the prescribed deadline. The application correction facility will remain available from 24 September to 13 October 2026. MP Police ASI Recruitment Apply Online- Active Link How to Apply for MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026? उम्मीदवार MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 के लिए 24 September 2026 से 8 October 2026 तक ऑनलाइन आवेदन कर सकते हैं। आवेदन करने के लिए नीचे दिए गए चरणों का पालन करें: Visit the official MP ESB website www.esb.mp.gov.in Go to the Online Form section on the homepage. Click on the application link for the Subedar (Ministerial), Stenographer and Assistant Sub Inspector (Ministerial) Recruitment Examination 2026. Enter the required details and complete the registration process. Log in using the registered credentials and fill out the application form. Enter your personal, educational and other required details carefully. Upload your photograph, signature and required documents in the prescribed format. Pay the applicable application fee and portal charges as per your category. Carefully check all the details entered in the application form. Submit the application form and download the application receipt/confirmation page for future reference. Selection Process The MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 selection process will be conducted in multiple stages. Candidates who qualify for one stage will be eligible to appear in the subsequent stage. Stage Description 1. First Phase – Online Written Exam Computer-Based Test (CBT) – 100 marks 2. Second Phase – Practical Exam Shorthand/Typing Test – 100 marks 3. Document Verification Verification of all original certificates 4. Medical Examination & Character Verification Final fitness and background check MP Police ASI Exam Date 2026 The MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 written examination will begin from 3 November 2026. The exam will be conducted in two shifts, from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM and 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM, with a duration of 2 hours for each shift. Candidates should check their admit cards for the exact exam date, shift and reporting time. MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026: Exam Pattern The MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 written examination will be conducted in online Computer-Based Test (CBT) mode. The exam will consist of 100 questions for 100 marks, and there will be no negative marking for wrong answers. Subject Marks Number of Questions General Knowledge & Reasoning 40 40 Intellectual Ability & Mental Aptitude 30 30 Science & Simple Arithmetic 30 30 Total 100 100 MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026: Salary Candidates selected for the MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 will receive a salary as per the Madhya Pradesh Government pay rules. The salary will vary according to the post, pay level and applicable allowances. Along with the basic pay, selected candidates may receive allowances and other benefits as admissible under the rules. S.No. Post Name Pay Scale (Pay Band) 1 Subedar (Ministerial) – Stenographer Rs. 36,200 – Rs. 1,14,800 2 Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI) (Ministerial) Rs. 19,500 – Rs. 62,000 Also Check MP Police ASI Syllabus 2026 MP Police Previous Year Question Paper 2026 MP police SI Salary 2026 FAQs When will the online application for MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 begin? The online application process has started on 24 September 2026, and the last date to apply is 8 October 2026. How many total vacancies have been announced? A total of 655 vacancies have been notified for Subedar (Ministerial/Stenographer) and ASI (Ministerial) posts. When will the MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026 exam be conducted? The written examination will begin from 3 November 2026. Is Hindi shorthand required for the ASI (Ministerial) post? No, Hindi shorthand is not required for the ASI (Ministerial) post. Candidates must have the prescribed CPCT with Hindi typing qualification. What is the application fee for MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026? The application fee is ₹500 for UR candidates and ₹250 for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates belonging to Madhya Pradesh. What is the selection process for MP Police ASI Recruitment 2026? The selection process includes the written examination, practical test, document verification, physical measurement and medical examination, as prescribed in the recruitment rules. What is the salary of MP Police ASI? The pay scale for ASI (Ministerial) is ₹19,500–₹62,000, while Subedar (Ministerial)-Stenographer has a pay scale of ₹36,200–₹1,14,800. items.title: MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025, Apply Link Active Till 19 Nov
items.doc_text:
Exams » MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025 The Madhya Pradesh High Court (MPHC) has announced the MP High Court Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025 for 41 vacancies. Interested and eligible candidates can submit their online applications for the Data Processing Assistant (DPA) post through the official website www.mphc.gov.in from 29 October 2025 (12:01 PM) to 19 November 2025 (11:55 PM). This recruitment offers an excellent opportunity for candidates with a degree in Computer Science or IT and relevant professional experience. The direct application link is provided in this article for easy access to the online form. The last date to apply online for the MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025 is 19 November till 11:55 PM. MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025: Overview MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025 has been announced for eligible candidates seeking government jobs in Madhya Pradesh High Court. This recruitment offers a great opportunity for aspirants with computer and data management skills to join the judicial services. MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025 Organization High Court of Madhya Pradesh (MPHC) Post Name Data Processing Assistant Total Vacancies 41 Advertisement No. S2A/Exam/DPA/2025 Application Start Date 29 October 2025 (12:01 PM) Last Date to Apply Online 19 November 2025 (11:55 PM) Correction Window 24 November 2025 (12:01 PM) – 26 November 2025 (11:55 PM) Exam Date TBA Official Website www.mphc.gov.in MPHC Data Processing Assistant Notification 2025 PDF The Madhya Pradesh High Court (MPHC) has released the official notification for the MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025 on its website – www.mphc.gov.in. A total of 41 vacancies are available for the post of Data Processing Assistant. This is a good opportunity for candidates who have a degree in Computer Science, IT, or similar fields. The online application form is available from 29 October 2025 to 19 November 2025. Before applying, candidates should read the MPHC Data Processing Assistant Notification 2025 PDF to understand the eligibility, salary, selection process, and vacancy details. Don’t miss this chance to secure a reputed government job under the Madhya Pradesh High Court! MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025 – Notification PDF MPHC Data Processing Assistant Important Dates 2025 Candidates must take note of all the key dates, including the application start, last date to apply, correction window, and exam schedule, to ensure they don’t miss any important event in the recruitment process. MPHC Data Processing Assistant Important Dates 2025 Events Dates Notification Date 28 October 2025 Apply Start Date 29 October 2025 Apply Last Date 19 November 2025 Modify Application Form 24 – 26 November 2025 Exam Date TBA MPHC Data Processing Assistant Application Fees 2025 For the MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025, candidates belonging to the General category are required to pay an application fee of ₹943.40 while submitting their online form. Category Fees Unreserved Category Rs. 943.40/- Reserved Category Rs. 743.40/- Mode of Payment Online MPHC Data Processing Assistant Vacancies 2025 The Madhya Pradesh High Court has announced vacancies for the post of Data Processing Assistant under the 2025 recruitment drive. This opportunity aims to fill multiple positions across various categories. Interested candidates can apply online to secure a role in the state’s judicial system. MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025 Notification Data Processing Assistant (DPA) 41 MPHC Data Processing Assistant Online Form 2025 The MP High Court has started the online application process for 41 Data Processing Assistant (DPA) posts from 29 October 2025. Eligible candidates should apply as soon as possible and not wait for the last day. The last date to submit the MPHC DPA Online Registration Form is 19 November 2025. For your convenience, we have also shared a direct link below. Just click the link, register, fill in your details, and submit your form to apply for this great opportunity with the Madhya Pradesh High Court! MPHC Data Processing Assistant Application Form 2025: Active How to Apply for the MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025 The Madhya Pradesh High Court has explained a simple online procedure for applying to the Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025. Candidates just need to visit the official MPHC website, complete the registration, fill in all required details, and upload the necessary documents. After that, they must pay the application fee and submit the form before the last date. Visit the official website www.mphc.gov.in. Click on the “Recruitment/Result” tab. Select Online Application Form/Admit Card. Click on “Registration” and fill in the required details. After registration, log in with your User ID and Password received on your registered mobile/email. Fill in the application form, upload your recent photo and signature, and preview the form carefully. Pay the examination fee and submit the form. Take a printout of the application form for future reference. MPHC Data Processing Assistant Qualification 2025 For the MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025, candidates must meet specific educational qualifications set by the Madhya Pradesh High Court. Educational Qualification Educational Qualification: B.Sc. (Computer Science) / BCA / B.Sc. (IT) or an equivalent degree with minimum 60% marks or equivalent grade in graduation. Experience: Working knowledge of Operating Systems and Office application suites with 3 years of experience in data entry work with the required qualification. Age Limit Candidates applying for the MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025 must be between 18 to 35 years of age as of January 1, 2025. Age relaxation in the upper limit will be applicable to reserved categories as per government norms. MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025 Selection Process The selection process for MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025 will be conducted in multiple stages to ensure fair evaluation. Candidates will be shortlisted based on a written examination followed by a skill test and document verification. Written Exam Practical Test Interview Document Verification Medical Examination MPHC DPA Exam Pattern 2025 The MPHC DPA Exam Pattern 2025 is crucial for the candidates to plan and prepare for the exam. The exam will be conducted online/ CBT Mode. Candidates can check the detailed subjects and their weightage shared below. The duration of the exam is 2 hours Each question carries 1 mark A total of 100 questions will be asked Subjects/ Topics Questions Marks Computer Networks & Information Security 100 100 Programming Methodologies and Data Structures Computer System Architecture Object-Oriented Programming Database Management System Operating System Concepts Computer Organization & Architecture Object-Oriented Concepts Design & Analysis of Algorithm Data Communication & Computer Networks Operating System Internet of Things & Applications MPHC Data Processing Assistant Salary 2025 Candidates selected for the MPHC Data Processing Assistant (DPA) post will be appointed under Grade Pay ₹2,400, with an initial basic salary of around ₹20,200 as per the 6th Pay Commission. The total in-hand salary after including allowances typically ranges between ₹28,000 – ₹32,000 per month, depending on the posting location and experience. In addition to the basic pay, employees receive various government benefits such as House Rent Allowance (HRA), Dearness Allowance (DA), Travel Allowance (TA), Employees’ State Insurance (ESI), Provident Fund (PF), and other perks as per the High Court Service Rules. Over time, salary increases are provided through annual increments, promotions, and revisions under new pay commissions. FAQs What is the last date to apply for MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025? The last date to apply online for the MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment is 19 November 2025. What is the age limit for MPHC Data Processing Assistant Recruitment 2025? Candidates must be between 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2025, with age relaxation as per government rules. Exams » MPPSC Transport SI The MPPSC Transport SI Recruitment 2025 has been officially announced by the Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC) to fill a total of 35 vacancies for the post of Transport Sub-Inspector (SI). The online application link was activated on 12 September 2025, allowing eligible candidates to submit their applications through the official website — mppsc.mp.gov.in. Candidates with a Diploma in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering and a valid Heavy Vehicle Driving License are eligible to apply for the MP Transport SI Vacancies. The MP Transport SI Apply Online Link is now active, and applicants are advised to submit their forms early to avoid last-minute issues. MPPSC Transport SI Recruitment 2025 The MPPSC Transport SI Recruitment 2025 Notification has been officially released on the commission’s website. Eligible candidates interested in the Transport Sub Inspector (SI) posts should read the notification carefully and apply online before the last date. The MPPSC Transport SI Apply Online Link is active now, and applicants must complete their registration well before the deadline to avoid last-minute technical issues. Don’t miss this opportunity to secure a government job in the Madhya Pradesh Transport Department — use the direct link provided below to download the notification and apply online. MPPSC Transport SI Answer Key 2026 – Download PDF MPPSC Transport Sub Inspector Notification 2025 The Madhya Pradesh Transport SI Apply Online Link is activated. Candidates should be aware of the key information shared in the MP Transport SI Notification PDF. MPPSC Transport Sub Inspector Notification 2025 Recruiting Organisation Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission Post Name Transport SI Vacancies 35 Advt. No 02/2025 Educational Qualification 3 year diploma in Mechanical/ Automobile engineering Age Limi 21 – 40 Selection Process Written Exam, PST, Driving Test, Document Verification, Medical Examination Pay Scale Rs. 5,200-20,200 Grade Pay Rs. 2800 Official Website https://mppsc.mp.gov.in/ MPPSC Transport SI Notification 2025 PDF The MPPSC Transport SI Notification 2025 PDF contains comprehensive information regarding the recruitment process, including eligibility requirements, age limits, application guidelines, selection procedure, salary details, and other essential instructions. Aspirants are strongly advised to go through the official notification thoroughly before filling out the online application form to ensure they meet all the criteria. The official MPPSC Transport SI Notification 2025 can be easily downloaded from the commission’s website — @mppsc.mp.gov.in. MPPSC Transport SI Recruitment 2025 MPPSC Transport SI Recruitment 2025 Important Dates Department officials will reactivate the ‘Apply Online’ link from 12 September to 13 November 2025 on the official website. Earlier the candidates who applied from 20 June to 19 July 2025 are need not to apply again. Check the application and correction window dates mentioned in this article. MPPSC Transport SI Recruitment 2025 Important Dates Event Dates Apply Online Link 12 September 2025 Last Date To Apply 13 November 2025 Last Date To Correct Online Application 15 November 2025 Exam Date TBA MPPSC Transport SI Vacancy 2025 The commission has announced a total of 35 Transport SI Vacancies vide Advt no,, 02/2025 on the official website. Candidates interested in applying can check the detailed category wise vacancy details shared below. MPPSC Transport SI Vacancy 2025 Category Vacancies UR 10 SC 6 ST 7 OBC 9 EWS 3 Total 35 MPPSC Transport SI Apply Online Link 2025 The MPPSC Transport SI Vacancy 2025 online application process began on 12 September 2025, and candidates can submit their applications until 13 November 2025. The commission has also opened a correction window from 13 September to 15 November 2025, allowing applicants to make necessary edits to their submitted forms. It is important to note that candidates who had already applied earlier in June 2025 are not eligible to reapply for this recruitment. Interested and eligible applicants can use the direct link provided below to complete their registration for the MPPSC Transport SI Recruitment 2025 before the deadline. MPPSC Transport SI Apply Online Link 2025- Active How To Apply For MP Transport SI Recruitment 2025? The application window for the MPPSC Transport SI Recruitment 2025 will be reopened. Candidates interested in applying can follow the below mentioned steps to submit their application without any errors. Visit the official website: mppsc.mp.gov.in or mponline.gov.in. Click on the “Apply Online” link or cicl on MP ONLINE Services link to visit the login page. If you are a new user then click on “Register” and fill in the required details. Log in with the credentials provided during registration Check for the MP Transport Inspector Application form and click on it to enter all the details. Pay the required application fees before the last date to avoid technical details. Apply and take a printout for future reference. Also check MPPSC Transport SI Syllabus FAQs How many vacancies are released in MPPSC Transport sSI Apply Online Link? The department has announced a total of 35 vacancies using won. When will the apply online link for MPPSC Transport SI be activated? The MPPSC Transport SI Apply online link is activated on 12 September. प्रवेश-पत्र की उपलब्धता

4, इस विज्ञापन के अंतर्गत विज्ञापित पदों हेतु इन्दौर, भोपाल, जबलपुर एवं ग्वालियर स्थित परीक्षा केन्द्रों पर वस्तुनिष्ठ
प्रश्नों की 0/॥२ आधारित परीक्षा आयोजित की जाएगी। परीक्षा में प्राप्त अंकों के गुणानुक्रम के आधार पर विभिन्न श्रेणियों
हेतु विज्ञापित पदों के तीन गुना तथा समान अंक प्राप्त करने वाले अभ्यर्थियों को साक्षात्कार हेतु आमंत्रित किया जाएगा।
परीक्षा तिथि एवं प्रवेश-पत्र उपलब्धता तिथि की यथासमय आयोग की वेबसाइट mppse.mp.gov.in पर प्रकाशित किया
जाएगा।

हेतु व्यय प्रतिपूर्ति का वर्गीकरण प्रावधानित है, जिसके अनुसार नियमानुसार भुगतान की कार्यवाही सम्पादित की जाती है।
अतएबव इस संबंध में किसी भी माध्यम से प्राप्त अभ्यावेदनों को स्वीकार नहीं किया जाएगा।

items.title: MP Police SI Apply Online 2025 Starts For 500 Sub Inspector Posts, Apply Now
items.doc_text: Exams » MP Police SI Apply Online 2025 The Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board is going to recruit the eligible candidates for 500 Sub Inspector posts in the Police Force department in Madhya Pradesh. The notification is already released in previous days. Today, the MPESB has activated the online application form link for SI posts on the official portal @esb.mp.gov.in. To get the MP Police SI Apply Online 2025 form link, candidates can refer to the given article. MP Police SI Admit Card 2026 – Download Link MP Police SI Apply Online 2025 Out To apply for the Sub Inspector posts, every candidate will have to meet the eligibility criteria in terms of Educational Qualification and Age limit. As per the notification, all graduate candidates are eligible for these posts, and the age limit of these candidates varies from 18 to 25 years. Every candidate must note that the MP Police SI Apply Online 2025 form link will remain active on 10 November 2025. After this, no application will be received from any candidate. MP Police SI Apply Online 2025 Link Activated: Key Highlights Recruitment Organization Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) Post Name Sub Inspector (SI) Vacancy 500 Category Apply Online Status Released MP Police SI Apply Online 2025 27 October 2025 Last Date To Apply 10 November 2025 Official Website @esb.mp.gov.in MP Police SI Apply Online 2025 Form Link Activated: Direct Link The direct online application form link for MP Police Sub Inspector posts is now available on the official website @esb.mp.gov.in. All candidates who want to apply for these posts must review the proper instructions for SI posts and upload all the original documents in the application form on the official MPESB website If any document is missing or invalid in the application form, then the application form is rejected at any level. For the ease of the candidates, we have provided the direct link to apply for the SI posts in the given article. MP Police SI Apply Online 2025 Link Activated: Apply Now MP Police SI Online Application Form Fee Details While submitting the online application form, every candidate will have to submit the online application form fee on the official portal @esb.mp.gov.in. The application form fee for MP Police Sub Inspector posts will be deposited through any mode, such as debit card, credit card or any digital mode. For the ease of the candidates, we have provided the application form fee details in the article below Category Application Type Application Fee General / OBC / EWS For Direct Recruitment Posts ₹500 SC / ST / PWD For Direct Recruitment Posts ₹250 Unreserved Candidates (Police Dept.) For Departmental Examination ₹200 SC / ST / OBC / EWS (Native of MP) For Departmental Examination ₹100 Steps For Submitting the MP Police SI Apply Online Form 2025 Here, for the candidates’ convenience, we have provided the direct steps for submitting the online application form for MP Police SI posts on the official portal @esb.mp.gov.in. These steps are simple and every candidate can easily apply for these posts by following the steps one by one. These steps are given below Visit the official website esb.mp.gov.in Check eligibility criteria, important dates, and fee details Keep all documents ready – photo, signature, certificates, ID proof, etc. Scan the photo and signature in the required format and size Create your candidate profile on the MPESB portal Fill in basic details like name, address, and ID information Upload your scanned photo and signature Lock your profile after verifying all information Log in using your Profile ID and Password Select MP Police SI Recruitment 2025 from the application list Fill personal, educational, and category details correctly Review all details carefully before submission Proceed to the payment section Pay the application fee online (Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI) Wait for payment confirmation and download the receipt Click on Final Submit to complete your application Download and print your Application Form and Payment Receipt If the correction window opens, edit details within the given dates Also check MP Police SI Syllabus MP Police SI Salary MP Police SI Previous Year Question Papers FAQs When will the MP Police Apply Online 2025 form link be activated? The last date is to apply for the MP Police SI Vacancy 2025 is 10 November 2025. What is the last date to make correction in the MP Police SI Apply Online 2025 form?
