items.title: MP Police Constable Exam Date 2025 Out, Check Exam Schedule & Pattern
items.doc_text:
Exams » MP Police Constable Vacancy 2026 The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has issued the MP Police Constable Recruitment 2026 notification for 7,500 Constable (General Duty) vacancies. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online through the official recruitment portal from 22 September to 06 October 2026. Candidates can check all key information related to the MP Police Constable Bharti 2026 below, including vacancy details, eligibility requirements, age limit, application fee, PET/PST requirements, examination pattern, and salary details. MP Police Constable New Vacancy- Download PDF The detailed notification of the MP Police Constable Vacancy is now available on the official portal at esb.mp.gov.in. It includes details such as vacancies, eligibility criteria, application dates, fees, physical standards, exam pattern, selection process, and other important instructions. For the ease of the candidates, we have provided the direct link to download the notification PDF in the article below MP Police Constable 2026 Notification PDF MP Police Constable भर्ती 2026: विवरण, महत्वपूर्ण तिथियां The MP Police Constable recruitment is being conducted for General Duty posts under the Madhya Pradesh Police. Check the important recruitment details below. Particulars Details Recruiting Authority Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) Department Police Headquarters, Home (Police) Department, Madhya Pradesh Post Name Constable (General Duty) Total Vacancies 7,500 Notification Release Date 9 September 2026 Application Mode Online Application Start Date 22 September 2026 Last Date to Apply 6 October 2026 Application Correction Window 22 September to 11 October 2026 Written Exam Date From 19 November 2026 Pay Scale ₹19,500–₹62,000 Selection Process Written Exam, Physical Test, Document Verification and Medical Examination Official Website esb.mp.gov.in MP Police Constable Vacancy 2026: Posts -Wise The MP Police Constable Bharti 2026 includes 7,500 Constable (GD) vacancies. These posts are divided between the Special Armed Force (SAF) and other police units. 1. Constable (GD) – Special Armed Forces (SAF) – 700 Posts Category Total Vacancies Open 525 Ex-Servicemen (10%) 70 Home Guard (15%) 105 Grand Total (SAF) 700 2. Constable (GD) – Non-SAF (General Duty excluding SAF) – 6,800 Posts Category Total Vacancies Open 2,720 Ex-Servicemen (10%) 680 Home Guard (15%) 1,020 Female (35%) 2,380 Grand Total (Non-SAF) 6,800 MP Police Constable Apply Online: Direct Link The online application process for MP Police Constable Recruitment 2026 is now live on official website. Eligible candidates can apply through the MPESB official website or the link provided below. The last date to submit the application form is 6 October 2026. Candidates should complete the registration, enter their details accurately, upload the required documents, and pay the application fee before the deadline. MP Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Apply Online Link MP Police Constable भर्ती 2026: आवेदन शुल्क Candidates must pay the prescribed examination fee while submitting the online application. The fee depends on the candidate’s category and the mode used to submit the application. Category Exam Fee Portal Fee (MP Online) Total Payable Unreserved (UR) ₹500 ₹60 (Kiosk) / ₹20 (Online) ₹560 / ₹520 SC / ST / OBC / EWS (MP Domicile) ₹250 ₹60 (Kiosk) / ₹20 (Online) ₹310 / ₹270 The portal fee is ₹60 through a Kiosk and ₹20 when the application is submitted without using a Kiosk. Candidates making corrections in their application are required to pay the applicable correction fee. MP Police Constable भर्ती 2026 के लिए ऑनलाइन आवेदन कैसे करें? Candidates can follow the steps below to complete the MP Police Constable Recruitment 2026 online application process: Visit the official MPESB website at esb.mp.gov.in. Find and click on the MP Police Constable Vacancy 2026 application link. Complete the registration process and enter the required personal, educational, and domicile details. Upload the required documents, including a recent photograph and signature, in the prescribed format. Pay the applicable application fee through the available online payment mode. Carefully review all the details before submitting the application form. Submit the application and download the confirmation page/application form for future reference. Documents Required To Upload Photograph ( फोटो ): A recent and clear colour passport-size photograph. Signature ( हस्ताक्षर ): A clear scanned copy of the candidate’s signature. Educational Certificates: Class 10th/12th marksheet or certificate, as applicable. Caste/Category Certificate: Required for candidates claiming reservation benefits. Aadhaar Number/VID: Required for biometric verification. Employment Registration: Valid registration with the Madhya Pradesh Employment Office, wherever applicable. MP Police Constable 2026 Application Correction Window Candidates who have submitted the MP Police Constable Application Form 2026 can make necessary corrections during the correction window. The correction facility will be available from 22 September to 11 October 2026. Candidates should carefully check all details in the application form and make the required changes within the given period. Correction Charge: ₹60 (Correction Fee) + ₹20 (Portal Fee) = ₹80/- per transaction. What Can & Cannot Be Edited in MP Police Constable Application Form? Candidates can check the table below to know which details can be corrected during the application correction window: Allowed Not Allowed Candidate’s Name, Father’s / Mother’s Name,Date of Birth (DOB), Educational Qualification, Category / Sub-Category, Photograph & Signature, Address & Communication, Exam Centre Preference Basic Profile Registration, Mobile Number & Email ID, Application Number MP Police Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026 Candidates interested in the MP Police Constable Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the eligibility conditions prescribed by the recruitment authority. The eligibility is mainly based on nationality, Madhya Pradesh domicile, age limit, and educational qualification. Nationality: The candidate must be an Indian citizen. Domicile: Madhya Pradesh domicile is mandatory for candidates claiming reservation or age relaxation benefits. Other-State Candidates: Candidates who are not permanent residents of Madhya Pradesh can apply only against Unreserved (Open) vacancies and will not be eligible for MP-specific reservation or age relaxation. Education: Candidates must possess the required educational qualification prescribed for their category Post Category Minimum Educational Qualification Constable (GD) UR / SC / OBC / EWS 10+2 (Higher Secondary) or equivalent examination passed from a recognised board/institution Constable (GD) ST (Scheduled Tribes) 8th Class Pass or equivalent examination from a recognised board/institution MP Police Vacancy 2026 Age Limit The MP Constable age limit 2026 is prescribed as on 06 October 2026. Candidates must be at least 18 years old to apply, while the maximum age limit varies depending on the candidate’s category and applicable relaxation. Category Minimum Age Maximum Age Relaxation General (UR) – Male 18 Years 33 Years – General (UR) – Female 18 Years 33 Years – SC / ST / OBC – Male (MP Domicile) 18 Years 38 Years 5 Years SC / ST / OBC – Female (MP Domicile) 18 Years 38 Years 5 Years Government Employees (MP) 18 Years 38 Years 5 Years Ex-Servicemen (MP Domicile) 18 Years As per rules Service period deduction Retrenched Government Employees 18 Years Max 3 yrs above limit Up to 7 yrs service deducted Non-MP Domicile Candidates 18 Years 33 Years No relaxation What is the Selection Process? The selection process includes a written examination followed by physical and qualifying stages. Candidates can understand the complete selection flow as follows: Written Examination → Physical Efficiency Test (PET) → Document Verification → Medical Examination → Final Merit List The final merit list will be prepared based on the combined marks of the Written Examination and PET, subject to qualifying document verification and medical examination. MP Police Constable शारीरिक मापदंड (PST) Candidates appearing for the MP Constable Vacancy 2026 must meet the prescribed physical standards. The requirements differ for SAF and Non-SAF posts, while separate provisions are applicable to female and transgender candidates. 1. 2.2  (i) आवेदक क े पास Ɋूनतम शैƗिणक अहŊतायŐ आवेदन पũ भरने की ितिथ को अिनवायŊ ŝप से पूणŊ होने चािहये ।  
        (ii) आवेदन पũ भरने की ितिथ क े पʮात िकसी भी िदनांक को अहŊतायŐ अिजŊत करने वाले अɷिथŊयों को िवǒािपत पदों क े िलये 
िवचार Ɨेũ मŐ होने की पाũता नहीं होगी ।  
       (iii) परीƗाओं की गोपनीयता, शुिचता एवं सम̾ याओं को ̊िʼगत रखते Šए आवेदन-पũ मŐ यिद कोई अ̰ यथŎ एक से अिधक पदों क े  
िवक̵ प चुनता है, तो उस अ̰ यथŎ को सभी चुने गये पदों की यो̑ यता का Ůमाण-पũ अपलोड िकया जाना आव̻ यक होगा।  
 (iv) िकसी भी ̾ तर पर अ̰ यथŎ Ȫारा उ̋ त अपलोड िकये Ůमाण-पũ का बोडŊ ̾ तर से क े वल परीƗा आयोजन क े  उȞे̻ य से परीƗण

पास वैधािनक कायŊवाही करने का अिधकार सुरिƗत रहेगा।  
 (v) आवेदक Ȫारा गलत जानकारी िदये जाने की İ̾थित मŐ उनका आवेदन पũ िनरˑ िकया जा सक े गा । 
   (vi) ऑनलाइŊन आवेदन-पũ मŐ भरी गइŊ जानकारी का सȑापन चयन क े समय संबंिधत िवभाग/सं̾था या भतŎ परीƗा से संबंिधत

2.15   ऑनलाइŊन आवेदन-पũ क े साथ संलư िकये जाने वाले दˑावेजों का िववरण :-

 (i) आनलाइŊन आवेदन पũ क े साथ अɷथŎ का कलर फोटो, हˑाƗर एवं ˢयं की हˑिलपी को िनधाŊįरत Ůाŝप/ फामőट मŐ

items.title: MP Police SI Recruitment 2025 Notification out for 500 Vacancies, Apply online
items.doc_text:
Exams » MP Police SI The Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB), Bhopal, has released the official notification for Subedar/Sub-Inspector Recruitment Examination 2025 under the Home (Police) Department of the Madhya Pradesh Government. The MP Police SI Vacancy 2025 recruitment aims to fill various posts in the Police Department through an online examination and subsequent selection process. MP Police SI Vacancy 2025 The MP Police SI Recruitment offers an excellent opportunity to join the police department. The MPESB has released the official SI Recruitment 2025 Notification on its website . This notification includes complete details about the vacancies, application procedure, age relaxation, and other essential guidelines. MP Police SI Recruitment 2025 Overview Candidates interested in the MP Police SI Vacancy 2025 should review key details on the official website. The table below provides information on the selection process, expected vacancies, and the notification release date. MP Police SI Vacancy 2025 Overview Exam Details Recruiting Organisation: Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) Post Name: Sub Inspector Mode of Application: Online Vacancies: 500 Selection Process Stages Involved: Physical Standard Test PST/ PMT, Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, Document Verification, Interview Eligibility Criteria Educational Qualifications: Graduation Age Limit: 18-40years Important Dates Online Application Start Date: 27 October 2025 Last Date to Apply Online: 10 November 2025 Important Links Official Website: https://esb.mp.gov.in/ Apply Online: Inactive MP Police SI Vacancy 2025 Notification PDF The official notification titled MP Police Subedar/Sub-Inspector Recruitment Examination 2025 has been released by MPESB. It contains complete details related to eligibility, selection stages, exam structure, reservation, and application guidelines. The examination will start on 9 January 2026 and will be conducted in two sessions, from 9:30 AM to 11:30 AM and from 2:30 PM to 4:30 PM. The exam will be objective in nature and conducted in both Hindi and English languages. MP Police SI Recruitment 2025 Notification PDF MP Police SI Vacancies 2025 The Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has announced a total of 500 vacancies for the posts of Subedar and Sub-Inspector under the MP Police Department. The vacancies are divided across three main posts – Subedar, Sub Inspector (GD–Special Armed Force), and Sub Inspector (GD–Other than SAF). The distribution of vacancies as per category and reservation is given below. Post Code 01 – Subedar Category UR OBC SC ST EWS Total Open 3 1 2 1 4 11 Ex-Servicemen (10%) 1 0 1 0 1 3 Police Department (15%) 1 0 1 0 2 4 Female (35%) 2 1 2 1 4 10 Total 7 2 6 2 8 28 Post Code 02 – Sub Inspector (GD–Special Armed Force) Category UR OBC SC ST EWS Total Open 20 9 10 9 23 71 Ex-Servicemen (10%) 2 1 2 1 4 10 Police Department (15%) 4 2 2 2 4 14 Total 26 12 14 12 31 95 Post Code 03 – Sub Inspector (GD–Other than SAF) Category UR OBC SC ST EWS Total Open 40 20 21 20 49 150 Ex-Servicemen (10%) 10 5 5 5 13 38 Police Department (15%) 16 7 8 7 19 57 Female (35%) 36 18 18 18 42 132 Total 102 50 52 50 123 377 Madhya Pradesh Police SI Apply Online 2025 The Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) will activate the online application link for MP Police Subedar and Sub-Inspector Recruitment 2025 on its official website www.esb.mp.gov.in. Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can submit their application forms online only. The application window will remain open from 27 October 2025 to 10 November 2025, while the correction window will be available from 27 October 2025 to 15 November 2025. We will update the direct application link here as soon as the online registration begins. MP Police SI Important Dates 2025 The Madhya Pradesh Employee Selection Board (MPESB) has released the official schedule for the Subedar/Sub-Inspector Recruitment Examination 2025. Candidates must complete the online application process and corrections within the specified dates mentioned below. Event Dates Online Application Start Date 27 October 2025 Last Date to Apply Online 10 November 2025 Correction Window Opens 27 October 2025 Correction Window Closes 15 November 2025 Examination Start Date 09 January 2026 Mode of Exam Online (Computer-Based Test) MP Police SI Eligibility Criteria 2025 The candidates who clear the graduation and falls between 18-40 years are eligible to apply for MP Police Sub Inspector posts. MP Police SI Eligibility Criteria 2025 Category Eligibility / Educational Qualification Subordinate (General Unit – except special armed units) Must have a graduate degree or equivalent from any recognized university Subordinate (General Unit – Special Armed Units) Subedar Educational qualifications for each category are as mentioned in the table above. No relaxation in educational qualifications will be provided. However, in exceptional cases, the competent authority may recommend inclusion of a candidate who does not meet the listed qualifications but is considered suitable based on the authority’s discretion. Candidates with degrees from foreign universities not recognized by the government will not be eligible. Age Limits Candidates must meet the required age as on 10.11.2025. Maximum age relaxations are applicable as per Madhya Pradesh government rules for specific categories. Sl. No. Category / Applicant Maximum Age Limit (Years) Remarks 1 Male – General category, Madhya Pradesh resident 33 – 2 Male – Economically Weaker Section (EWS), Madhya Pradesh resident 33 – 3 Male/Female – All other state residents 33 – 4 Female – All categories 38 Only for Madhya Pradesh residents 5 Male – Scheduled Castes / Scheduled Tribes / Other Backward Classes 38 Only for Madhya Pradesh residents 6 Male – Employees of government/corporation/public sector and municipal services 38 Only for Madhya Pradesh residents 7 Male – General / EWS category with inter-caste marriage 38 Only for Madhya Pradesh residents 8 Female – General / EWS category with inter-caste marriage 43 38 + 5 years, only for Madhya Pradesh residents 9 Male – General category who are war/paramilitary award winners 38 33 + 5 years, only for Madhya Pradesh residents 10 Female – General category who are war/paramilitary award winners 43 38 + 5 years, only for Madhya Pradesh residents 11 Male – SC/ST/OBC category who are war/paramilitary award winners 43 38 + 5 years, only for Madhya Pradesh residents MP Police SI Selection Process 2025 The selection process of MP Police SI includes the following stages: Preliminary Examination (100Marks) Physical Proficiency Test Main Examination (300Marks) Interview (50Marks) MP Police SI Exam Pattern 2025 The candidates preparing for the MP Police SI Exam should be aware of the latest exam pattern and syllabus shared in the official website. The commission will conduct prelims and mains examination. MP Police SI Preliminary Exam Pattern 2025 Subjects Marks Duration Hindi Reading Comprehension 100 2 hours English Reading Comprehension Analytical Ability History Geography Science Civics Basics of Computing Knowledge Current Affairs Mains Exam Pattern The MP Police SI Mains Exam includes two papers each for 150 marks. The duration of the exam is 2hours. There will be negative marking for each incorrect answer in the mains examination. MP Police SI Physical Standards Test (PST) 2025 MP Police SI Physical Standards Test (PST) includes Height and Chest measurements. Candidates can check the MP Police SI PST Details from the table below. MP Police SI Physical Standards Test (PST) 2025 Category Height Chest Male (Gen& OBC) 168 cm 81-86 cm Male (SC& ST) 160 cm 76-81 cm Female 155 NA MP Police SI Physical Proficiency Test: This test is compulsory for all the candidates. Candidates who qualify this test will be shortlisted for the next stage of recruitment process. This test shall be of 100 marks and include the following: MP Police SI Physical Proficiency Test: Events Marks Male Female 800 Mtrs running 40 less than 124.2seconds less than 176.0 seconds Long Jump 30 5.57mtrs 4.36m Shot Put 30 greater than 8.76m greater than 7.20 relaxation is provided for ex-servicemen and technical posts i.e Arms/Photo/Questioned Documents/Fingerprint. MP Police SI Syllabus 2025 The MP Police Sub Inspector Syllabus is the gateway for the candidates, as it provides detailed information about the important topics/subjects. Aspirants should go through the MP Police SI Syllabus and Exam Pattern and prepare detailed fool proof strategy to clear the exam in first attempt. MP Police SI Salary 2025 Candidates selected for the MP Police Sub Inspector (SI) position will be entitled to a range of government benefits and allowances. The grade pay for the position is Rs. 4,200, and the MP Police SI Salay ranges between Rs. 45,000 and Rs. 55,800 per month. In addition to the base salary, the MP Police SI salary package includes various perks, allowances, and other financial benefits, which enhance the overall compensation. As government employees, candidates will also have the opportunity to receive promotions and incremental salary increases over time based on their performance and service duration. Also check MP Police SI Previous Year Question Papers FAQs When will the MP Police Recruitment 2025 be released? The MP Police SI Recruitment 2025 will be released in April or May 2025. How many vacancies will be released in MP Police SI Recruitment 2025? Approximately 500 vacancies are expected to be released through MP Police SI Recruitment 2025. items.title: WCD MP Anganwadi Recruitment 2025,19503 Posts, Last Date Apply Now
items.doc_text:
Exams » WCD MP Anganwadi Recruitment 2025 The Women and Child Development Department, Madhya Pradesh, has released the official notification for 19503 Anganwadi posts across various departments in the state. The WCD MP Anganwadi Recruitment 2025 drive includes vacancies for Anganwadi Workers and Assistants. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online from 20 June 2025 through the official WCD portal. With the last date to apply by 4th July 2025 , candidates are advised to complete the application process without delay. This article covers key details such as eligibility criteria, application steps, fees, and more. Scroll down to check the complete information. The last date to apply online for WCD MP Recruitment 2025 is 4th July. WCD MP Recruitment 2025 Notification PDF The detailed notification of WCD MP Recruitment 2025 has been made available on the official website @chayan.mponline.gov.in. The notification of WCD has provided the important key information for Anganwadi Worker and Assistant posts, for which every candidate is required to much important to a proper analysis and then apply for these posts. The key information, such as eligibility criteria, selection process, application form, syllabus, salary and important dates, etc. For the ease of the candidates, we have also provided the direct download link of the notification PDF in the given article. WCD MP Recruitment 2025 Notification Out – Download Here WCD MP Anganwadi Recruitment 2025 The Women and Child Development (WCD) Department is accepting online applications from eligible candidates who meet the required educational qualifications and age criteria. This is a great opportunity for 12th pass candidates seeking government jobs in Madhya Pradesh, with a large number of vacancies announced. The selection process includes a merit list based on 12th marks, followed by document verification and a medical test. For a quick overview, refer to the table below. WCD MP Recruitment 2025: Key Highlights Recruitment Organization Women And Child Development Department, Madhya Pradesh Post Name Anganwadi Worker And Anganwadi Assistant Vacancies 19503 Category Notification Status Released Education Qualification 12th Pass Age Limit 18 To 35 Years Selection Process Merit List, Document Verification And Merit List Official Website @chayan.mponline.gov.in. WCD MP Vacancy 2025 Post-Wise The WCD has announced a total of 19503 vacancies for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Assistant along with the notification PDF on its official website. Out of 19503, there are 17477 posts for Anganwadi Assistant and 2027 posts for Anganwadi Worker position. For the ease of the candidates, we have provided post-wise information in the table given below. WCD MP Vacancy 2025 Post-Wise Anganwadi Worker 2027 Anganwadi Assistant 17477 WCD MP Anganwadi Important Dates 2025 The Online application for WCD MP Anganwadi Recruitment 2025 has been initiated from 20 June 2025 in the official website @chayan.mponline.gov.in. The last date to submit the online application is 04 July 2025. Candidates can also go through the given table to get more details about this event. WCD MP Anganwadi Important Dates 2025 Notification Release Date 19 June 2025 Online Application Date 20 June 2025 Last Date to Apply 04 July 2025 Merit list TBA WCD MP Online Application Form 2025 The Women and Child Development Department, Madhya Pradesh, has released the online application form for various posts under the WCD MP Anganwadi Recruitment 2025. Interested and eligible candidates must apply through the official website before the last date, 04 July 2025. Aspirants should submit their online application and pay the required fees before 04 July 2025 to confirm their candidature. For your convenience, a direct application link is provided in the article below. WCD MP Online Application Form 2025 – Apply Now Steps for How To Submit the WCD MP Online Application Form 2025 Here, for the convenience of candidates, we have provided the simple and easy steps for how to fill and submit the online application form 2025 for WCD MP Anganwadi Worker and Assistant posts on the WCD website. Those candidates who do not know the procedure regarding the submission form can follow these steps one by one and apply for these posts. Go to the official portal of WCD MP @chayan.mponline.gov.in Look for the link that says “WCD MP Recruitment 2025” or “Apply Online” under the latest announcements. Click on the application link for the desired post you want to apply for. If you’re a new user, register with your basic details like name, mobile number, and email ID. Use your registration number and password to log in. Enter your personal, educational, and other required details carefully. Upload scanned copies of your photo, signature, and necessary documents in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online via debit card, credit card, or net banking (if applicable). Double-check all the details and click on the “Submit” button. After submission, download and print the application confirmation for future reference. Eligibility Criteria for WCD MP Recruitment 2025 To apply for the Anganwadi Worker and Assistant positions under WCD MP Recruitment 2025, candidates must meet the following criteria: Educational Qualification Anganwadi Worker : Must have passed Class 12 (Intermediate) from a recognized board. Anganwadi Assistant : Minimum qualification is Class 5 pass Age Requirements (as of 01 January 2025) Minimum Age : 18 years Maximum Age : 35 years Reserved category candidates will receive age relaxations according to the Madhya Pradesh government rules Residency Requirement Applicants must reside in the same revenue village (for rural roles) or ward (for urban roles) where the vacancy is located; otherwise, their application may be rejected. WCD MP Selection Process 2025 Merit-Based Shortlisting – Based on marks in Class 12 (Worker) or Class 5 (Assistant). Document Verification – Original certificates will be checked. Medical Test – Candidates must pass a fitness check. Final Appointment – Issued after all stages are cleared. WCD MP Anganwadi Salary 2025 The candidates who selected as Anganwadi Worker or Anganwadi Helper in WCD MP are entitled to get monthly salary as per the government norms. Candidates will get additional perks and allowances in additional to the basic pay. WCD MP Anganwadi Salary 2025 Anganwadi Worker Rs.11500 Anganwadi Helper Rs.7000 FAQs When will the WCD MP Recruitment 2025 Notification be released? The WCD MP Recruitment 2025 Notification has been released on 19 June 2025 at the official website of WCD. How many vacancies regarding Anganwadi Worker and Assistant will be covered under WCD MP Recruitment 2025? A Total of 19503 vacancies for Anganwadi Worker and Assistant will be covered under this recruitment. When will the online application for WCD MP Recruitment 2025 be started? The Online Application for WCD MP Recruitment 2025 has been started from 20 June 2025 on the official portal. What is the last date to submit the online application form for WCD MP Recruitment 2025? The Last date is to submit the online application form for Anganwadi Posts is 04 July 2025. What are the educational qualifications required for WCD MP Recruitment 2025? Applicants must have passed 12th standard for Anganwadi Worker/Assistant eligibility under WCD MP Recruitment 2025 How will candidates be selected under WCD MP Recruitment 2025? Selection for WCD MP Recruitment 2025 is strictly merit-based, using 12th marks followed by document verification and medical check-up. items.title: MP Group 4 Exam Date 2025 Out, Check Revised Exam Schedule and Vacancies
items.doc_text:
Exams » MP Group 4 Exam Date 2025 The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has updated the Group 4 Exam vacancies and exam date . Candidates who applied to the MP Group 4 Recruitment 2025 should be aware of the revised exam date and admit card release date shared in this article. Candidates should check the MP Group 4 Exam Date 2025 and prepare for the exam according to the latest schedule. MP Group 4 Exam Date 2025 Out The MPESB Group 4 Recruitment 2025 aims to fill 966 vacancies in various state government roles. The exam, originally set for 30th March 2025 , is now rescheduled to 7th May 2025 . The apply online link is closed. All the candidates who applied to the MPESB Group 4 and 3 Stenographer posts can now check the latest exam schedule and the exam timings shared in the official website. For the convenience of the candidates here, we have shared the official webnote. MPESB Group 4 Admit Card 2025 Out MPESB Group 4 Recruitment 2025 Notification Overview Candidates applying for the MPESB Group 4 Exam should refer to the official notification for key information, ensuring they meet all requirements and understand the exam’s specifics. MPESB Group 4 Recruitment 2025 Notification Overview Exam Details Recruiting Organisation: Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) Post Name: Group 4 (Stenographer, Assistant Grade-3, Stenotypist posts) Vacancies: 966 (Revised) Apply Mode: Online Exam Fees: Rs.500 (UR) Important Dates MP ESB Group 4 Notification: 24 January 2025 Apply online starts from: 17th March 2025 Last date to apply for MPESB Group 4: 22nd March 2025 Window for correction: – MP ESB Group 4 Admit Card: 30 April 2025 MP Group 4 Exam Date 2025: from 7th May 2025 Eligibility Criteria Educational Qualifications: 12th Pass and Steno certificate Age Limit: 18-40Years Selection Procedure Stages Involved: Written examination, Certificate verification Salary Salary: Varies from posts Ranges from: Rs.19,500-91,300 Important Links Official Website: https://esb.mp.gov.in/ Apply Online: Active ESB Group 4 Recruitment 2025 Notification PDF Candidates applying for the MPESB Group 4 Recruitment 2025 should download and carefully review the official notification PDF at esb.mp.gov.in . This will help them understand the eligibility criteria , selection process , and other essential requirements before submitting their application. It is crucial to follow all instructions mentioned in the notification to ensure a successful application. MPESB Grade 4 Recruitment 2025 – Download PDF MPESB Group 4 Vacancy 2025 (Revised) The MP Employees Selection Board has revised the Group 4 vacancies to 966 posts , including backlog vacancies. The recruitment covers roles such as Stenographer, Assistant Grade-3 , and Stenotypist . See the detailed category-wise breakdown in the table below. MPESB Group 4 Revised Vacancies 2025 Category Vacancies Additional Vacancies UR 278 2 EWS 84 1 OBC 150 2 SC 229 2 ST 215 3 Total (966) 956 10 MPESB Group 4 Apply Online 2025 The board has reactivated the apply online link is closed. Candidates who applied to the MPESB Recruitment 2025 are eligible to appear for the exam. The MP Group 4 Exam is scheduled to be held on 07th May 2025. Steps to Apply for MPESB Group 4 Candidates interested in applying for Madhya Pradesh ESB Group 4 should follow the below mentioned steps to submit their online application. Step 1: Visit the official website of MP online @https://www.mponline.gov.in/portal/ and click on “Citizen Services” and then click on “ESB”. Step 2: You will be redirected to a new web page. Check for the Group 4 online application link and click on it. Step 3: If you are a new user click on “Register” and fill in the required details to complete your profile registration. If you are an existing user, click on Apply Now and Login using your Application number, transaction ID, and Date of birth. Step 4: Fill in the required details, and upload a Photo, Sign, hand written declaration to complete your online application. Step 5: Review your application and pay the required fees to submit your online application. Step 6: Download or take a printout of your online application for future use. MPESB Group 4 Eligibility Criteria 2025 Candidates applying for MP ESB Group 4 Should meet the required educational qualifications and age limit shared in the official notification. The eligibility criteria is crucial in selecting the desired candidates for the Group 4 posts. Educational Qualification: Candidates should complete 10+2 or equivalent education and have 1year Computer diploma/ certificate from a recognised body/university. Typing speed of at least 20WPM in Hindi and 30WPM in English. Age Limit Candidates should meet the required age limit, the cutoff date to calculate the age limit is 01/01/2024. The minimum and maximum age have shared below: MPESB Group 4 Eligibility Criteria 2025 Age Limit Category Age limit UR/General 18-40Years SC/ST/OBC, Govt employees 18-45 Female 18-45 MPESB Group 4 Selection Procedure 2025 The MPESB Group 4 selection process consists of two stages: a written examination and document verification. Candidates who clear the written test will be called for the verification of their certificates, and the final result will be announced thereafter. To ensure success, aspirants should thoroughly understand the MPESB Group 4 syllabus and exam pattern and plan their preparation strategy accordingly. MPESB Group 4 Exam Pattern 2025 The Madhya Pradesh ESB Group 4 selection process includes a written test. The candidates who submitted their online application can download their admit card and appear for the exam. The exam pattern consists of: Subjects Marks Duration General Knowledge 100 3hours General Hindi General English General Mathematics Computer Knowledge General Aptitude ESB Group 4 Syllabus 2025 The MPESB will conduct an online examination for all candidates who have applied for the Group 4 Exam. Applicants are advised to thoroughly review the official MP ESB Group 4 syllabus and exam pattern to enhance their chances of clearing the exam in their first attempt. For your convenience, we have provided a detailed syllabus that candidates can refer to for effective preparation. MPESB Group 4 Syllabus MPESB Group 4 Salary 2025 The salary for MP ESB Group 4 positions differs depending on the role. Stenographer Grade 7 , Assistant Grade-3 (Level 4) , and Stenotypist (Level 6) positions offer a pay scale ranging from ₹19,500 to ₹91,300 . This includes the basic pay along with additional benefits like Dearness Allowance (DA) , House Rent Allowance (HRA) , and other government perks, all of which vary based on the role and responsibilities. Also check MP Group 4 Previous Year Question Papers FAQs How many vacancies are released in MPESB Group 4 Recruitment 2025? The MP Employees Selection Board has released 966 Vacancies. What are the posts released in MP ESB Group 4 Recruitment 2025? The posts include Stenographer, Assistant Grade-3, Stenotypist What is the MP Group 4 Exam Date 2025? The MP Group 4 Exam Date 2025 has been officially announced. The exam will be conducted on 07th May 2025 Will the MP Group 4 Exam be conducted in multiple shifts? Yes, the exam may be held in multiple shifts depending on the number of applicants. Shift details will be mentioned on the admit card. What is the mode of MPESB Group 4 Exam 2025? The exam will be conducted in online (Computer-Based Test) mode. items.title: MPPSC Prelims Result 2025 Out, Download Merit List PDF
MPSC Group C Result 2024, Stenographer Merit List Out
items.doc_text:
Exams » MPSC Group C Result 2024 Maharashtra Public Service Commission has announced the most awaited MPSC Group C Result 2024 on the official website. Candidates who appeared the Stenographer interview schedule from 15 October to 30 November 2024 can check the result PDF and confirm their selection from the link shared in this article. The MPSC Group C Stenographer Result 2024 PDF consists of the candidates selected for the stenography posts. MPSC Group C Result 2024 Out MPSC Group C Stenographer Notification has announced to recruit a total of 253 posts. The commission has conducted the online exam, skill test and interviews and released the final merit list. MPSC Group C Result 2024 is the final and candidates find their name in the result PDF indicates their selection in the recruitment process. Here, we have shared the MPSC Group C Result 2024 PDF download and check your result. MPSC Group C Result 2024 Key Information Madhya Pradesh Service Commission has released the Group C Stenographer Exam should check the latest information about the result from the table below: MPSC Group C Result 2024 Key Information Recruiting Organisation Maharashtra Public Service Commission Post Name Group C Stenographer Total Vacancies 253 Selection Process Online Exam Skill Test Interview Merit List MPSC Group C Result 2024 06 November 2024 Official Website https://mpsc.gov.in/home MPSC Group C Result 2024 Merit List PDF The MPSC Group C Result 2024 has been released in the form of a PDF carrying the name, roll number, and cut-off of the shortlisted candidates. Candidates should download the MPSC Stenographer Result 2024 and check their selection status, visit the official website or click the link below to download the MPSC Stenographer Result and Eligible candidates list PDF 2024. MPSC Group C Result 2024 Merit List Download PDF MPSC Group C Result 2024 Eligible Candidates List Download PDF Steps to Download MPSC Group C Stenographer Result 2024 Candidates looking to download the MPSC Group C Stenographer Result 2024 can follow the below mentioned steps to download it. Step 1: Visit the official website of MPSC @https://mpsc.gov.in/home Step 2: On the home page check “Latest Updates” and then click on MPSC Group C Stenographer Result. Step 3: Click on “Advt.No.044/2022 Steno-Typist (English), Group-C – Announcement regarding result” to view the result PDF. Step 4: Check your name to confirm your result. Download and take a printout of your result to confirm your selection. Details mentioned in MPSC Group C Stenographer 2024 Result Candidates who downloaded the MPSC Group C Stenographer Result 2024 should check the details shared in the merit list PDF. ENGAGEMENT OF CONSULTANT / ADVISOR
(ENGINEER & FOREMAN/SENIOR TECHNICIAN) IN BHAVINI

(Only employees retired / due to retire by last date of receipt of application from BHA VINI/ NPCIL/
DAE and its Constituent Units. are eligible to apply)

l) Applications are invited from retired employees of BHAVINI/NPCIL/DAE and its constituent
units for engagement as Advisor / Consultant.

2) Retired employees/ employees due to retire by last date of receipt of application who is willing
to work in BHAVINI can submit their application in the prescribed format (Annexure-A) along
with the passport size photograph duly affixed and a copy of the Pension Payment Order.

3) Applicants retired/retiring from the post of Scientific Officer/F level or equivalent (Level —

~ 43) and Foreman/Senior Technician or equivalent (Level 8) - from BHAVINI / NPCIL/
DAE and its Constituent Units may apply for the below post:

(Level 8) Electrical Maintenance — 2

Instrumentation Maintenance -2

4) 7096 applications received will be scrutinized by the Selection Committee. The Committee may
interact with the candidates if required and shall assess the candidates as per the selection
process. The selected candidates will be communicated the date of commencement of work
and the period of tenure after approval of CMD, BHAVINI.

5) Engagement of selected candidate will be based on vigilance clearance/vigilance inputs from
the organization/s the officer has served during a period of l0years prior to retirement, subject
to the conditions applicable as per procedure for engaging retired employees in BHAVINI.

6) Eligibility:

5.. Applicant should have retired from BHAVINI/NPCIL/DAE or its Constituent
Units.

5.2 Applicant should possess excellent domain knowledge and experience in the
capacity. (Refer Annexure — B)

5.3. The engagement shall be purely on temporary basis.. Engagement can be
terminated at any time by BHAVINI without assigning any reason.


 
जल Entitlements:

6.l The official on engagement is entitled to fixed monthly amount arrived at by
deducting the basic pension from the last pay drawn (only basic) at the time of
retirement. The remuneration shall remain unchanged for the term of contract.

6.2 To and fro transport facility shall be provided for travel between place of
residence (Anupuram) and the place of work : if required to travel outside the
place of posting in connection with official work, they will be governed under TA
rules as applicable to BHAVINI on the pay scale as they were getting at the time
of their superannuation.

6.3 No increment, Dearness Allowance and HRA shall be admissible during the term
of re-engagement.

6.4 Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 2 days for each completed month
of service. The leave so earned can be taken either in every month or accumulate and
avail in one or more spells within the tenure period.

6.5 The term of appointment shall ordinarily be for an initial period not exceeding six
months which is extendable by another six months (subject to availability of
vacancy). Further extension may be granted based on a review of the task and the
performance of the engaged appointee, provided it shall not be extended beyond five
years after superannuation.

6.6 The engaged officer shall not be entitled to contribute towards GPF, Gratuity etc.
for the period of engagement.

6.7 The officials so engaged will be provided available accommodation / Guest
House with License Fee during the period of their engagement as Consultant /
Advisor in BHAVINI. Also, accommodation may be provided subject to the
condition that the Consultant / Advisor or their spouse does not own a house
within the specified radius of the vicinity. Appropriate License fee p.m. will be
charged.

8) The place of work will be at BHAVINI, Kalpakkam.

9) The engaged personnel need to perform the duties as per working hours of BHAVINI on all working
days.

0) This department has right to reject any application without assigning any reason

ll) Last date of receipt of application is seven days from the date of issue of this

Advertisement. Incomplete and late applications will not be considered.

2) The applications can be forwarded by post in a sealed envelope to the following address.

Monitoring and control of vital parameters in TG, Steam and water system, and auxiliaries.

SCOPE OF WORK & RESPONSIBILITIES OF CONSULTANT

MECHANICAL

Engineer SO/F Level- | No.

Should have worked as Mechanical Maintenance engineer in 220MWe and above nuclear
power plant in TG and Auxiliary systems.

Nature of job:

Reviewing the maintenance procedures for TG and auxiliary systems
Coordinate turbine rolling, barring gear operation and trial runs.
Maintenance of governing valves, control valves and stop valves.
Maintenance of EHC (Electro-Hydraulic Control) system.

Check functioning of turbine trip and emergency protection systems.
Maintenance of lube oil, control oil and jacking oil systems.
Maintenance of condensate extraction pumps (CEP).

Maintenance of boiler feed pumps (BFP) and their driving turbines/motors, as applicable.
Maintenance of cooling water pumps and seal water pumps.
Maintenance of gland steam condenser and gland sealing system.
Maintenance of vacuum pumps and air ejectors.

Maintenance of heat exchangers, oil coolers and filters.

Maintenance of circulating water and auxiliary cooling systems.
Maintenance of HP and LP bypass valves.

Foreman/Senior Technician- 2 Nos

Should have worked as Foreman/Senior technician in Mechanical Maintenance in 220MWe
and above nuclear power plant in TG and Auxiliary systems.

Nature of Jobs:

Conduct inspection of pumps, motors, gearboxes and rotating equipment.
Checking mechanical seals, gland packing, bearings and couplings.
Perform shaft alignment using dial gauges and laser alignment equipment.
Inspect piping, valves, flanges and expansion joints.

Carry out hydraulic testing and pressure testing wherever required.
Identify oil leakage, water leakage and steam leakage.

Monitor equipment health through vibration and temperature analysis.
Check rotor run-out, eccentricity, shaft alignment and bearing clearances.
Inspect and maintain journal bearings and thrust bearings.

Check bearing metal temperature, vibration and oil parameters.

Monitor differential expansion, axial displacement and rotor eccentricity.
Inspect gland sealing and labyrinth sealing arrangements.

Supervise dismantling, cleaning, and inspection of internal components.

Checking and servicing of motor, gearbox, bearings, and seals.

Preparation of service and test reports.
